Millonarios scraped past Junior but then got roughed up by Bucaramanga and Colo-Colo at home, so the pressure's on to find some consistency. Pasto? They're even messier — just one win in five, though that 3-0 demolition of Bogotá FC shows they can click when it matters.

Key storylines:

- **Millonarios** need to protect their home record after back-to-back losses at El Campín
